all_contenders.name: Duke Of Lancaster
all_contenders.reason: Placed 3rd at Bundaberg last outing and has prior Kilcoy placing experience. Mid-tier country performer who will benefit from scratching shifts to land a mid-pack rail run.

all_contenders.name: Bolla Bolla Babe
all_contenders.reason: Faded fresh at Rockhampton but gets an immediate gear/position upgrade moving to barrier 4. Handles soft going well and possesses tactical early speed to hold position around the first turn.

danger_horse.name: Claw Machine
danger_horse.reason: Massive weight relief carrying only 49kg after William Galloway 4kg claim. Showed explosive early gate speed when winning at Toowoomba two starts back and boasts previous placing form at Kilcoy over 6f. Dangerous front-runner under featherweight.
